$comment: Checked-in exception list (REQ-ARCH-40; review 13 F48): dependencies whose licence is NOT on the permissive allowlist but is knowingly accepted, each with a rationale. An allowlist without an exception list dies by undocumented exceptions. Keep every entry justified; CI reads this file.

@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk.rationale: The Agent SDK is a proprietary dependency the whole run model depends on — the largest control concession in the design (Q-3, §12.1 REQ-ARCH-4). Mitigated by the Engine abstraction (REQ-ARCH-7). Hosted under our own brand; never surfaced or marketed as 'Claude Code'.

@resvg/resvg-js.rationale: Server-side SVG→PNG rasterizer in the worker only (P1.13, §7.5 figure render@2x.png — resolves §16.3 #8); weak copyleft used as an unmodified dependency; never in a client bundle.

@resvg/resvg-js-darwin-arm64.rationale: Platform binary of @resvg/resvg-js (same package, same use — see that entry): server-side SVG→PNG rasterizer in the worker only, unmodified, never in a client bundle.

axe-core.rationale: The WCAG 2.2 AA checker UX.2 runs inside the journeys harness (ADR-068) — dev/test tooling only, executed by Playwright's page context, never in a shipped client bundle or server image. MPL-2.0 is weak copyleft; used as an unmodified dependency.

elkjs.rationale: Transitive dep of beautiful-mermaid (P1.13 Mermaid→SVG layout, packages/figures). EPL-2.0 is weak copyleft; used as an unmodified dependency for diagram layout in the worker only, never in a client bundle.

pandoc.rationale: Used only in the isolated `export`/`convert` containers, invoked as a SEPARATE PROCESS over files — no linking into our TypeScript. GPL's copyleft is not triggered by separate-process invocation. Not an npm dependency; shipped in the container image.

typst.rationale: PDF rendering in the `export` container; separate process. Apache-2.0 is permissive but recorded here because it is a system binary, not an npm dep, so the automated npm scan cannot see it.

util-linux.rationale: SEC.3 — the three applets (setpriv, unshare, mount) are statically built from the pinned upstream tarball and vendored into the distroless run-task image; invoked as SEPARATE PROCESSES by absolute argv — no linking into our TypeScript. GPL copyleft is not triggered by separate-process invocation (the pandoc precedent). Source is fetched from kernel.org, SHA-256-pinned at build.

libcap-ng.rationale: SEC.3 — statically linked into the vendored util-linux setpriv (Alpine ships no libcap-ng .a, so it is built static from the pinned upstream source). Static linkage into a GPL-2.0 binary yields a GPL-2.0 whole anyway; the binary is a separate process, never linked into our TypeScript. SHA-256-pinned at build.

dumb-init.rationale: SEC.3 — the static PID-1 init in the distroless run-task image (reaper + signal forwarder; the equivalent-approved tini substitute, ADR-074). Permissive, but recorded because it is a system binary built from the pinned upstream source — the npm scan cannot see it.

fonts.rationale: Bundled font files (SIL Open Font License and vendor licences) shipped as assets in export/marketing containers. Redistribution terms honored per font; enumerated in LICENSES.md as fonts are added.

demo-corpus.rationale: The demo corpus (packages/demo-corpus/corpus/** plus derived snapshots/goldens) is licensed content by 'S. J. Sebastian', not source: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 per GD-DEMO-LICENSE.R7 / ADR-127 / REQ-DOPS-3. Code in the package stays MIT; enumerated in LICENSES.md 'Content outside the MIT grant'.

duck.rationale: Transitive dep of mammoth (docx conversion, apps/convert) via lop. The declared SPDX string is the bare 'BSD', but the checked-in LICENSE file is the permissive 2-clause text (no advertising clause) — equivalent to allowlisted BSD-2-Clause. Server-side conversion only; never in a client bundle.

pako.rationale: Transitive dep of mammoth via jszip (docx conversion). The declared SPDX expression is a conjunction of two permissive licences — MIT is allowlisted and Zlib is a permissive zlib licence. Server-side only.

@fontsource-variable/inter.rationale: SIL Open Font License 1.1 — the §5.9 typefaces self-hosted via Fontsource (P1.01, REQ-IDE-39). OFL permits bundling + webfont embedding; the files ship as served woff2 assets (apps/web/public/fonts), never modified, with copyright + licence intact. No Reserved Font Name issue: Fontsource publishes the unmodified upstream faces.

caniuse-lite.rationale: Browser-support DATA table consumed by browserslist inside the babel toolchain (@vitejs/plugin-react, @tanstack/router-plugin — SPA.1, ADR-106). Compile-time input only; it is never bundled, served, or executed — the compiled output is our own code. CC-BY-4.0 permits use with attribution; the committed dependency record + LICENSES policy carry it.

lightningcss.rationale: Optional CSS toolchain peer of Vite (vite cssMinify: 'lightningcss') resolved once vite@8 entered the graph (SPA.1, ADR-106). Build-time CSS transformer only — what ships is our transformed CSS, not lightningcss code. MPL-2.0 is weak file-level copyleft; used as an unmodified dependency (the axe-core / resvg precedents).

lightningcss-darwin-arm64.rationale: Platform binary of lightningcss (same package, same use — see that entry): optional Vite CSS-toolchain peer, build-time only, unmodified, never in a client bundle.
